title: Ayys LMAO sets its summons face-down
notes: S+ #76 Ayys LMAO's three summons are set face-down in the caster's backrow by their Cloaked through the summon verb's new setCloaked (R4327000), no Unit summoned at the set or the reveal (R4327001); with no backrow zone open one is summoned face-up as before; R3557003's placement is superseded and the v0.6.8b script kept for replays (R4327002, R767000). Script and engine only: no catalog change. Rulings R4327000-R4327002.

player.title: Ayys LMAO sets its summons face-down
changes: Ayys LMAO's Ayys and Tiny Asteroids are set face-down in your backrow as Cloaked cards, hidden from your opponent until you Reveal them. With your backrow full they are summoned face-up as before.
